author: @DisIngRaM
text:
4:19

Only highly invested (+12 and lvl 90) can + high keeper level.

The think is, in the old d-tide, nothing can kill a player that has HP of 4000 and above.
So I think Light is only thinking in the direction of "what can I do to antagonize the whale endgame veteran player with HP of 5000"?

This is obvious if you look at the current problematic D-tide Wave 5 madness clear.
It's not only a matter of good team and wheels, it's also because their statsticks made their play possible (Like healing 1700 HP in 1 turn using a single click of caro's furnace. THIS IS NOT POSSIBLE when my team only has a maxHp of 2000).

Even if I copy their team, i still lose 100% of the time.
Not because my play is bad, I'm lacking the needed stats stick.

However, Light approach is definitely wrong, as this approach hurt all the playerbase; the casual, the try hards, and even the whales.
video_title: The D-Tide update was a disappointment

author: @DisIngRaM
text:
4:05
Even if light can clear it,
it is killing the spirit of teambuilding, if only few teams are allowed to clear it.

In contrast to that, the previous D-tide, you can even use half meme team and clear a-4 if not a-3 at worst (I don't think it can clear a-5)
What it allows is, it allow player to have fun with teambuilding, and making use of older awakener.
